paper_metadata.title: A New Base for Creating Castable High-Temperature Superalloys

evidence.quote: We studied an alloyed Ni3Al compound, which preserves an ordered fcc crystal lattice (L12) until the melting point (1395°C), has a density of 7.5 tons/m3, and exists in binary and more complex allying systems, as a base for creating castable high-temperature refractory alloys.
